title: Normalized scalar comparison data for completed compactifications
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$. Use the completed integral sheaves, exact strict coefficient-tower presentations, reductions, normalized limit presentations, ordinary section-model operations, evaluations and scalar squares of [def-sp-complete-compactification-limit-comparison]. For a compactification $c=(j,p)$, presentations $D_X,D_{\bar X},D_Y$, reductions $r_X,r_{\bar X},r_Y$, limit presentations $a_X,a_{\bar X},a_Y$ and evaluations $v_X,v_{\bar X},v_Y$, define a normalized scalar comparison datum to consist of: an ordinary natural isomorphism $U_X\mathbin{\ggg}j_{!,R}^{\mathrm{Tow}}\simeq j_{!,\bullet}\mathbin{\ggg}U_{\bar X}$; an ordinary natural isomorphism $U_{\bar X}\mathbin{\ggg}p_{*,R}^{\mathrm{Tow}}\simeq p_{*,\bullet}\mathbin{\ggg}U_Y$; and a derived isomorphism $(U_{\bar X})^D\mathbin{\ggg}Rp_{*,R}^{\mathrm{Tow}}\simeq Rp_{*,\bullet}\mathbin{\ggg}(U_Y)^D$. Each ordinary comparison, followed by the fixed finite evaluation comparison and finite scalar restriction, must equal the canonical ordinary open or pushforward scalar comparison at every strict tower and positive index. The derived direct-image comparison must satisfy the composition-unit normalization IsPushScalarNormalized relative to the ordinary direct-image comparison, on every complex. This defines a type of normalized data, asserting no inhabitant and no invertibility of any compactification limit word.
